annotations.title: Case studies: what we found, including in our own figures

description: ASPERN’s published case studies: errors we found in our own figures (a vault published at $609.5M that held $245k, withdrawals credited to the router instead of the owner, staked tokens priced at par, a veto misread on Morpho V2 vaults, an overstated coverage gap), findings about the market ($2.10B of book value in an impaired market with unrealised bad debt, advertised liquidity against what was really withdrawn), a venue API change that broke our readers, and a prediction we tested and did not ship. Without `slug`: the list, each with title, date, kind, networks, a one-line finding and the key figure with the day it was true. With `slug`: one study as Markdown with its sections and sources. Every figure is true on the date it names, not necessarily today; the study links the live page. FREE. Use case_study with a slug for one study in full.
name: case_studies
